text:
maria: Heads-up — opened a perf-sensitive PR #4271 that tweaks the KV-cache eviction thresholds. Bench shows a regression on long-context workloads. Need quick reviews and a triage plan before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4271 :eyes:

aj: Noted. Is this reg across model families or just the Llama-ish tests?

maria: Mostly Llama-variant tests with 8k+ contexts. Small/no change on short contexts. Quick summary and raw output below.

maria: ```
workload: chat-long-8k (batch=4)
baseline (main): p50=42ms p95=120ms qps=110
this PR:         p50=46ms (+9.5%) p95=132ms (+10%) qps=102 (-7%)
notes: increased prefix eviction aggressiveness to reclaim KV memory earlier (kv_cache_eviction_ratio 0.15 -> 0.05)
```

bench-bot: Auto-benchmark job finished: https://ci.redwood/builds/bench/2025-10-01/4271 - numbers match maria's local run. (attached logs)

devin: Hmm, that eviction ratio change would explain more cache misses for long sequences. Probably increases attention kv recompute work.

katie: Can we gate this behind a rollout / canary? Don't want customer regressions.

maria: Agree. I left the PR as draft until we get at least one perf + one infra approval. @aj can you look at the runtime kernel changes? @devin can you confirm the cache behavior?

aj: I can review kernel diff tonight. Quick skim: looks fine, one optimization moved memory free earlier. Will check race with batch executor.

devin: I'll run a targeted cache-trace locally. If eviction ratio is the culprit we can add hot-path heuristics: skip eviction for sequences > 4k or when recent access frequency high.

ci-bot: CI status: unit tests ✅, integration flaky test 'kv-cache-flush.test' failed on one matrix (retry queued)

maria: Thanks. If CI re-run passes and devin repros the reg, I propose: a) revert the eviction ratio change in main for now OR b) update PR w/ conditional eviction heuristics and run a canary in staging (small pool). Which do we prefer?

aj: Revert is fastest to eliminate risk. But if we can patch quickly with heuristics (devin), canary is fine.

devin: I'll prototype a conditional check today: pseudocode:

```
if (context_length > 4096 || recent_access_score(model_key) > 0.7) {
  skip_eviction();
} else {
  evict_if_needed(ratio);
}
```

devin: Should be low-risk. Can run perf harness in ~3h.

katie: Please don't merge until canary results are green. Add label `hold:perf` on the PR.

maria: Added label `hold:perf`. Also added a small perf job to CI that runs the 8k workload (low frequency).

bench-bot: Canary build scheduled on staging-canary-3, rolling to 3 nodes. Link: https://canary.redwood/jobs/4271-canary

deploy-bot: Canary started — monitor: https://monitoring.redwood/canaries/4271 (alerting thresholds: p50 + p95)

maria: Thanks all. Action items: @devin prototype conditional eviction (owner), @aj kernel review (owner), I'll wait for bench results then we decide revert vs patch.

aj: Will review by EOD PST.

devin: I'll post results in this thread. If I can't repro, I'll attach the trace and we can dig deeper.

maria: Perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
